title: Raindrop
tagline: Together a community's judgments form a social graph of trust. We can let funding follow it.
description:
Raindrop is a cryptoeconomic mechanism that continuously allocates new token issuance according to a token-weighted trust network. Each round:

- The protocol computes global allocation weights using EigenTrust based on current balances and trust delegations
- New tokens are minted according to the configured issuance rate
- Tokens are distributed proportionally to the allocation weights
- The process repeats with updated balances
- This creates an adaptive, self-adjusting flow where influence is conserved with respect to capital, providing Sybil resistance without external identity systems.
how_its_made: This project started as an idea that was sparked, but we used the hackathon as a way to harden the thesis, the protocol, the use-case and so much more. We spoke to open-source and DAO contributors and founders that have struggled with funding effectively throughout the event, which challenged the raindrop idea in many ways and finally got us to a point of confidence in its usefulness and stability. The end result is a whitepaper, simulations, and a battle-tested thesis so that the project is ready to be launched.
